about.heading: About Us
about.intro: We are a team of makers, engineers, and storytellers who believe great products come from curiosity, care, and close collaboration.
about.workplaceParagraph1: Our studio is a quiet corner of the internet — a place where small, focused teams ship work that feels personal. Every project starts with a conversation and ends with something we are proud to put our name on.
about.workplaceParagraph2: We keep the team small on purpose. That way every person owns their work end to end, every idea gets heard, and quality never becomes a negotiation.
about.teamBio: Acme Inc. builds tools for teams that move fast. For a decade we have helped product teams turn rough ideas into software people actually enjoy using — from first prototype to worldwide launch.
about.teamPhilosophyParagraph: We believe the best software is opinionated. It makes a few decisions well instead of deferring everything to the user. Every feature we ship has to earn its place by solving a real problem simply.
about.teamValuesParagraph: Clarity over cleverness, feedback over approval, and small autonomous teams over large committees. We hire for judgment and trust people to own their work end to end.
about.teamClosing: We are always looking for curious people to join the team. If our philosophy resonates with you, we would love to hear from you.
about.a1Heading: We exist to make complex things feel simple
about.a1Subtext: Every day we ask the same question: how do we turn an idea into something people actually love? The answer shapes everything we build.
about.a1MissionBody: We build software that respects people's time. That means fewer, sharper features — tools that get out of the way and let teams focus on the work that matters.
about.a1Value1Body: Every feature starts with a real problem a real person has. We listen first, build second, and let usage decide what survives.
about.a1Value2Body: We ship, measure, and iterate. Small experiments every week beat a big bet every year.
about.a1Value3Body: We would rather ship one thing that works beautifully than ten things that work okay.
about.a1Quote: The best products don't ask for more of your attention — they earn it back.
about.tabWithStatsDescription: Photo grid, stats and client logos
about.a2Heading: A small team with a big reach
about.a2Body: We are a remote-first company of builders spread across twelve time zones. Small by design, global by choice.
about.a2Why1: You work directly with the people who build — no account managers in between.
about.a2Why2: Fixed timelines and honest estimates. If something shifts, you hear it from us first.
about.a2Why3: Your code is yours. Clean, documented, and portable from day one.
about.a3Body: We started in a garage with two laptops and a whiteboard. Today we are a distributed team shipping products for companies on every continent — but the garage mentality is still the whole culture.
about.a3Aside: We believe the future of work is small, empowered teams armed with great tools. Our job is to build those tools.
about.a3CardBody: Every project is led end to end by a compact squad — no hand-offs, no committees, just people who care about the outcome.
about.a3SectionText: We pair deep technical expertise with a relentless focus on the user. Weekly demos keep everyone honest, and every release is measured against the goals we agreed on at the start.
about.a3Achievement3Body: where our users work every day
about.a4Body: A good product is a promise. A great product is a promise kept, year after year, by the people who made it.
about.a4Who1Body: Designers who write code and engineers who care about pixels.
about.a4Who2Body: We read, we travel, we break things — and bring what we learn back to work.
about.a4Who3Body: Transparent roadmaps, public retrospectives, honest numbers.
about.a4CtaHeading: We are always hiring curious people
about.a4CtaBody: If you want to own your work end to end, we should talk.
about.a5Caption: Every line of code we ship is code we would want to maintain ourselves.
about.a5StoryBody: We got tired of tooling that talks about developer experience without practicing it. So we built our own: boring-by-default, predictable, and fast enough that you forget it is there.
about.a5CrewParagraph1: A dozen people across four countries, most of us remote from day one. We review each other's code like it is our own and we treat docs as a first-class feature.
about.a5CrewParagraph2: No tickets, no standups, no drama. Just a shared README, honest PRs, and a deep respect for the craft.
about.a7Heading: From a side project to a product people love
about.a7Paragraph: What started as a weekend experiment became the company we run today. We stayed small on purpose, kept the speed, and never stopped listening to the people using what we build.
about.a7Point1Body: We prototype before we commit. Most ideas die on a whiteboard — the ones that survive get real users within a week.
about.a7Point2Body: Deadlines are real, but shortcuts are not. We ship on time by cutting scope, never quality.
about.a7Point3Body: Every design review starts with user recordings. If it does not help a real person, it does not ship.
about.a7CtaHeading: Want to know what we are building next?
about.a7CtaBody: Join the newsletter or come say hi — we reply to everything.
about.a8Heading: Building the rails for the next wave of fintech
about.a8Subtext: We power payments for teams who refuse to settle for clunky banking software.
about.a8MissionBody: Make financial infrastructure boring again. When the plumbing just works, founders can spend their energy on product, not on compliance.
about.a8ApiBody: One API for payments, payouts, and balances. Idempotent by design, webhooks you can trust, and an SLA that keeps us awake at night.
about.a8FoundersBody: We met building payments at a large bank and left to do it right. Ten years later we are still here, still in the details.
about.a9Bio1: I am a developer who cares about the last 10% — the keyboard shortcuts, the empty states, the error messages that tell you what to do next.
about.a9Bio2: For eight years I have built web products for startups and enterprises alike. I write code that other people can read, and I would rather ship small than ship late.
about.a9WorkBody: I take full ownership: from the first mockup to the last deploy. TypeScript end to end, tests where they matter, and documentation you will actually want to read.
about.a12Heading: Great software is built by great people
about.a12Body: We are an independent studio of senior engineers and designers. No juniors on your project, no account managers between you and the work.
about.a12CultureBody: The culture that attracts people is also the culture that keeps them. We protect our rituals the way we protect our deadlines.
about.a12Card1Body: We sell working software, not slideware. Every proposal starts with a prototype.
about.a12Card2Body: Opinionated by design. We would rather tell you what we think than what you want to hear.
about.a12Card3Body: Weekly releases, daily check-ins, and a bias for shipping over debating.
about.a13Intro: Every company has a beginning. Ours is a story of stubbornness, luck, and a lot of late nights.
about.a13Chapter1Body: In 2016, three colleagues were laid off on the same Tuesday. By Friday we had a name, a website, and our first client: a bakery that needed a better ordering system.
about.a13Chapter2Body: The bakery grew, and so did we. One product became five, five became a platform, and a platform became the thing we now call our flagship. We almost lost it all twice — both times we learned something worth keeping.
about.a13Chapter2ImageAlt: The team in the early years
about.a13Chapter3Body: Forty people, twelve countries, one mission: software that respects the people who use it. We still answer our own support emails, and we still celebrate every single deploy.
about.a14Heading: We build products that outlive their hype
about.a14Body: Fifteen years in, we have seen every trend come and go. What stays is the work: thoughtful products, honest teams, and users who stick around.
about.a14GlobalBody: We hire for judgment, not for timezone. Our meetings are recorded, our docs are asynchronous, and our offices are wherever our people are.
about.a14Bullet1Body: Coverage from Sydney to San Francisco
about.a14Bullet3Body: Work from anywhere you do your best work
about.a15Heading: We turn bold ideas into products people keep using
about.a15Body: Strategy, design, and engineering under one roof. You bring the problem, we bring the experience — and the shipping discipline.
about.a15HelpBody: Whether you have a question or a full product roadmap, we would love to hear from you.
about.a16Heading: Everything you need, nothing you don't
about.a16Body: We are not the biggest agency in the room. We are the one that ships.
about.a16ExpertiseBody: Senior people on every project — average of 10 years of experience.
about.a16SupportBody: Real humans who reply within hours, not ticket queues that reply within weeks.
about.a16SecurityBody: SOC 2 aligned, encrypted at rest and in transit, and audited every year.
about.a16SpeedBody: First working demo in two weeks, not two quarters.
about.a16TransparencyBody: Open roadmaps, honest budgets, and a shared dashboard you can check anytime.
about.a16ScalabilityBody: Architecture that starts small and grows to millions of users without a rewrite.
about.a16CtaHeading: Ready to build something worth keeping?
about.a16CtaBody: Tell us what you are working on — we will tell you honestly if we are the right fit.
about.a17Tab1Body: We are a software company founded in 2015 with a simple belief: good software should feel inevitable. Our tools are used by teams in more than 40 countries, from two-person startups to Fortune 500s.
about.a17Tab2Body: Our mission is to remove the friction between an idea and its users. We build platforms that handle the hard infrastructure so your team can focus on the part only humans can do.
about.a17Tab3Body: In ten years we want software teams to spend their time on problems, not plumbing. Here is what we are working toward:
about.a17Tab3Bullet1Body: Deploy with a single command, everywhere.
about.a17Tab3Bullet2Body: Great products make their users smarter over time.
about.a17Tab3Bullet3Body: Public APIs, public status, public pricing.
about.a18Heading: We build for people who build
about.a18Body: A small, senior team obsessed with the developer experience — our own included. We eat our own dogfood, then make the recipe public.
about.a18Feature1Body: Decisions in days, deploys in minutes.
about.a18Feature2Body: Honest pricing, honest timelines, honest feedback.
about.a18MissionHeading: Make building software feel like a craft again
about.a18MissionBody: Somewhere between the dashboards and the compliance forms, we lost the joy of making. We are here to bring it back — one boring, reliable, beautiful tool at a time.
about.a18Principle1Body: Reliability is a feature. We document, test, and ship patches nobody celebrates — so nothing ever breaks at midnight.
about.a18Principle2Body: Every hire, every meeting, every feature must earn its place. We stay small so the quality stays high.
about.a18Principle3Body: Every codebase, every process, every community we touch should be slightly better when we leave.
about.a19Quote: We are not building the biggest company. We are building the best one we know how to build — one honest day of work at a time.
about.a19Body: Growth is easy to measure and hard to value. We optimize for the other numbers: how many users recommend us, how many people stay for years, how proud we are at the end of the week.
about.a28Heading: A place where work feels like craft
about.a28Body: Four walls, a lot of light, and the feeling that every detail was chosen on purpose.
about.a28ValueBody: We argue about typography with the same seriousness we argue about infrastructure. Because both end up in the product your users see.
about.a28Bullet1Body: Nothing ships without being seen by three pairs of eyes.
about.a28Bullet2Body: Every Friday afternoon is dedicated to experiments, talks, and side quests.
about.a28Bullet3Body: Docs updated, tests green, branch merged — no loose ends for the next person.

applicationShell.s10Msg1Body: Hi team — we started seeing 502s right after the 4.12.0 deploy went out. Retries usually succeed, so it might be the edge cache.
applicationShell.s10Msg2Body: Thanks for the report! Checking our proxy logs now. Can you share the affected region and a couple of failing request IDs?

applicationShell.s10Msg4Body: Found it. A stale TLS certificate on one edge node. Rotated it and flushed the cache — should be fully back to normal.
